content:
E15 confirms it: all 5 retry-budget violations are exclusively from "Red Sea Parts" (first seen at t=457), while all other suppliers (and earlier Red Sea Parts orders from t=300) process fine. No deploy of worker or invoice-agent occurred. The sync-job deploy is a decoy — it affects ledger sync, not invoice parsing. The root cause is a change in the invoice format sent by the Red Sea Parts supplier starting around t=457.

  "summary": "All 3 retry-budget violations are caused by a new invoice layout from supplier 'Red Sea Parts' (first seen t=457) that invoice-agent cannot parse; no internal deploy or config change is responsible, so the issue must be escalated to the supplier."
}
